title: Draw a simple canvas shape
summary: Canvas is a drawing area controlled by JavaScript.
introduction: Canvas is a drawing area controlled by JavaScript. Your task: Change the rectangle width and colour.
learningObjectives: Change the rectangle width and colour.
Explain the example for draw a simple canvas shape

blocks.text: Canvas is a drawing area controlled by JavaScript. Its 2D context has commands for shapes and text.

Use these examples in a local page in a current browser. APIs involving files, storage, clipboard or location may need HTTPS, a user action or permission. They are shown as code because this site's sandbox limits those features.

blocks.code: <canvas id="art" width="240" height="120" aria-label="A blue rectangle">A blue rectangle</canvas><script>const ctx=document.querySelector("#art").getContext("2d");ctx.fillStyle="navy";ctx.fillRect(20,20,100,60);</script>
blocks.title: Draw a simple canvas shape

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `aria-label` supplies a name to assistive technology. It should explain the same purpose as the visible control or graphic.
`fillRect(x, y, width, height)` draws a filled canvas rectangle using the current fill style.
`querySelector` finds the first matching element. Check for a missing result when the element is optional.

blocks.text: A navy rectangle is drawn 20 units from the left and top, with a width of 100 and height of 60.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Canvas pixels do not provide the same readable structure as normal HTML. Give useful text for important information.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the rectangle width and colour.
